mechanism: Contextual bandit training on partial offline multi-turn trajectories
evidence_scope: we present contextual bandit learning with offlinetrajectories (Cobalt), a simple method that reuses offline multi-turn trajectories to efficiently train LLMs for multi-turn code generation.
